requirements.title: trials run executes a local-model SWE task suite via agent-manager's sandboxed runner, evaluates the diff against a fixture oracle, and records success/tokens/time history
requirements.description: `trials run` dispatches SWE tasks (add-feature/research/comprehend/bugfix + negative cases) through agent-manager's sandboxed primitive (profile ensure → task create → run create --run-mode sandboxed → poll run get → run diff, runner=opencode + local-model), then evaluates the produced diff in MoM against the fixture oracle (deterministic-first, agent-judge fallback; negatives pass on correct abstention) and appends success-rate + tokens + wall-time + fixture-rev to a historical time-series. agent-manager is the spawner only; the verdict is MoM's.

validation.notes: API: Runner seam-tested with a faked agent-manager CommandRunner (sequence + metric parse + step-error → VerdictError); Evaluator tested (oracle pass/fail, negative abstention, agent-judge fallback); Service idempotency + orchestration; target api/internal/trials.
E2E: sandboxed dispatch with a stub agent-manager run; target bas/cases/trials.
Live local-model e2e trial (expensive; operator-invoked); runbook in docs/internal/TESTING.md.

requirements.title: tracks % of Guide tasks with a live empirical gate
requirements.description: Each Guide-space task category maps to zero or more empirical gates; the trials domain computes and reports gate coverage over the Guide space as a recursive readiness metric.

validation.notes: API: gate-coverage computation over the Guide space; target api/internal/trials.
CLI: trials coverage output; target cli/domains/trials.

requirements.title: list the task suite and inspect a run with its sandbox diff
requirements.description: `trials list` enumerates the task suite generated from the Guide space, and `trials show <run-id>` returns one run with its verdict, tokens, wall-time, and the agent-manager sandbox diff reference that attributes changed files to that run.

validation.notes: API: ListTrialTasks from the Guide space + GetTrialRun with sandbox diff ref; target api/internal/trials.
